recommendation: Keep this source fix as-is. No separate reconciliation is needed here for the other r13840 tracker issues because they concern separate MedicationRequest or MedicationDispense/MedicationKnowledge changes.
issue_request: FHIR-15871 was Published as Persuasive for STU3 Pharmacy. It requested a way to represent different refill duration or quantity from the initial dispense; the approved resolution added MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.initialFill with 0..1 quantity and duration children and required a constraint that one of the two be filled.
initial_application: The Jira comments point to GForge/SVN build r13840, represented in git by 3ca8aaddb2c50c08732cad49f8ab68f086ba8c83. That commit added initialFill, quantity, and duration to the old medicationrequest spreadsheet source and included comment text about requiring quantity or duration, but the current source did not contain a formal invariant.
additional_context: MedicationRequest is active in source/fhir.ini, and the resource source has since moved from spreadsheets into source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml. Current source already had the requested backbone element and children with the expected cardinalities and types. Focused Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later decision reversing the at-least-one requirement.
reconciliation: Added an mps-1 error constraint to MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.initialFill with expression quantity.exists() or duration.exists(), making the existing prose rule machine-verifiable in the active StructureDefinition source.
source_changes: source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml: added mps-1 on MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.initialFill requiring quantity.exists() or duration.exists().
